full_page.content:
1928, May 28 1937, November
The following is a faithful transcription of hand written messages written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. on Seraphic Mass Association Cards.
Sister M. Cecilia
May 28, 1928 God Bless you Sr. Cecilia Kiss your Cross day by day Have peace!
Fr. Solanus, O.M.C.
Our Divine Model How little we are like Him! Nov. 1937 V. Sister Mary Solania - for God's special grace and guidance - God, bless you Sister M. Solania Be as blind to the faults of your neighbor as possible trying to at- tribute a good intension to their actions - at least.
Original in possession of: Sr. M.Solania Manturuk, CSSF. Felician Sisters 36650 Little Mack Mt. Clemens, Mich. 48043
